$comment: Clarifier rules for the Chat Guide — the 'deeper question' layer. A clarifier fires when a question names a topic and asks for an action but omits the one detail that decides which answer is correct. 'Mataas ang BP niya, ano gagawin ko?' is the canonical case: without knowing whether the client has symptoms, whether the BHW wants the threshold, or whether they want the referral destination, top-1 scoring has to guess — and today it guesses m1-hypertension-definition. Asking one authored question routes it correctly instead. Clarifiers are evaluated AFTER red flags (a symptom-bearing question is an emergency; do not stop to ask more questions) and BEFORE scoring. A clarifier fires only when every topic_any_of, intent_any_of and and_any_of group has a hit and no skip_if_any_of phrase is present. Phrases match whole-token against the normalized question. Options are authored bilingually and each maps to a published entry id, so a selection resolves by id and never re-runs scoring. Clarifiers are versioned content reviewed like KB entries, not model output.

clarifiers.question_en: Which is closest to your situation?
clarifiers.question_fil: Alin ang pinakamalapit sa sitwasyon mo?

options.label_en: The client has chest pain, a severe headache, blurred vision or trouble breathing right now
